title: Grateful Dead Live at Assembly Hall, University of Illinois on 1973-02-22
lineage: DAE and .shn conversion by G. Hamilton
source: MR > DAT > 1 cassette gen. > DAT > CDR 3x

ai_review.summary: Recording suffers from mis‑labeling and features an early, under‑developed version of "U.S. Blues" (listed as "Wave That Flag") that reviewers find disappointing.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers flag the track labeling error – what is listed as "Wave That Flag" is actually an embryonic form of "U.S. Blues" with weaker lyrics and a less polished arrangement. No comments are made about the audio fidelity, so the technical quality remains unclear, but the performance of this particular song is viewed negatively.

ai_rating.rationale: Two reviews both give a zero‑star rating and specifically criticize the song’s quality and mislabeling; no positive remarks are present.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers do not discuss sound clarity, balance, or source type; only note a labeling/track‑list issue.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The misidentified track creates confusion and detracts from the overall set flow for listeners.
